messages:
Emma (Solutions): Heads up — CarePath ran into a blocker during marketplace install. They need private image + govcloud KMS + cross-account VPC peering. @Raj can you pick this up? Installer times out during node bootstrap (apt/curl).

Raj (FieldEng): on it. can you drop the installer log/snippet?

Emma (Solutions): pasted log: ```
ERROR: timeout waiting for apt update
curl: (28) Operation timed out after 30 seconds
```
Installer runs from customer's restrictive NAT. They want to restrict egress to specific IPs.

Maria (PartnerSE): FYI CarePath legal requires image signing + attestation for marketplace. Do we have a temporary signed artifact flow for private deploys?

Devon (PM): We'll need the marketplace listing owners for attestation — cc @Liam. Also we should decide fallback (Dedicated vs Hosted) if attestation slips.

Liam (Infra): I can provision a temporary DMZ proxy and whitelist egress for bootstrap IPs. Raj — need exact IPs + ports. For image signing, we have IMAGE_SIG v1 flow; Maria I can share steps.

Raj (FieldEng): quick connectivity test script to run from customer's bastion: ```
for p in 80 443 12345; do nc -vz 3.212.45.99 $p; done
```
They report TCP 12345 closed (our registry proxy).

Emma (Solutions): Customer can open ports if we authenticate. Can we get a temporary signed image for them today? They need to keep the go-live.

Maria (PartnerSE): short yes on the temp image, but marketing wants to hold public joint announcement until attestation is complete.

Liam (Infra): I will escalate to infra-oncall to spin up a proxy in us-gov-west-1. @deploy-bot can you create a ticket?

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-8241 (CarePath marketplace bootstrap proxy). Assigned to Liam. ETA ~3h.

Raj (FieldEng): I'll coordinate with customer to run the connectivity test and then attempt a pull via proxy; will post results here.

Emma (Solutions): thanks — if we hit more issues let's do a 30-min triage call with CarePath + SI + us. Devon, can you schedule 2pm PT?

Devon (PM): scheduled 2pm PT — invite sent to CarePath-SI, partner-eng, infra.

Liam (Infra): proxy is live. IP 34.212.77.90 — Raj, try `docker pull registry.redwood.local/carepath:temp-signed` via the proxy.

Raj (FieldEng): pulled successfully, bootstrap progressed past apt step, node joined cluster. Marking bootstrap block resolved. Next items: finalize image signing and run marketplace attestation (Maria).

Maria (PartnerSE): I'll kick off the attestation runbook and request the govcloud KMS policy change. Ping me if we need a pre-signed artifact earlier.

Emma (Solutions): great work team :tada: keeping marketing in the loop. I'll update this thread after attestation completes.
